verdicts.reason: A rebuilds the layout for a square: product on top, then the one-line headline, then the subhead, so the reading order works. Its flaws: the product is centred while the text is left-aligned, the logo floats top-right on the decorative circle away from the text, and the bottom third is empty. B is just the banner layout spread over a square: the product is small and crammed against the right edge, the subhead sits far below the headline, there are large dead areas, and the logo is tiny.
